name: 19-pf-ceiling-band-15k-to-25k
why: Basic of 20,000, in the band that the Rs 25,000 ceiling (from 17 Sep 2026) newly covers: PF is 12% of the whole 20,000 each side, 2,400, and the pension share is 8.33% of 20,000 = 1,666. (Starts this month, so there is no income earlier in the tax year and the new-regime rebate covers the six months projected: no TDS.)
